gamefaqs.section: Action Replay Max DS (.duc) Game Save (North America)

format: Action Replay DS save: the 500-byte 'ARDS000000000001' header of the DualScene.net save archive ('0367 - Tetris DS (North America)', name 'DualScene #1'), then 256 KiB raw for the 8 KiB EEPROM (cut 262144 -> 8192; the rest was all 0xFF)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/nds-ards.py IN step0.bin, then tools/gamefaqs/nds-cores.py step0.bin --chip 8192 --stem 'Tetris DS (USA, Australia)' --out DIR: drops the Action Replay header; fits it to the 8192-byte chip (cut 262144 -> 8192; the rest was all 0xFF) and writes each core's file
